correctness.rationale: In homogeneous coordinates (t,u,v,w) on e1=0, write (X0,...,X4)=(t+u,t+v,t+w,t-u-v-w,t). Then e2=Q and e3=3tQ+C in characteristic five; thus the scheme is globally the projective cone over (Q,C), not just its displayed affine chart. The Gram matrix of Q is nonsingular modulo five, and each of the three cubic factors cuts the conic in two simple rational points; no pair of factors shares a point on the conic. The CI ideal is saturated, so the six reduced points give exactly six reduced projective lines and the vertex is the only singular point. The graded normalization is the product of six k[s], so the Hilbert series (1-t²)(1-t³)/(1-t)³ gives normalization length 5+3+1=9. The normalization of the projective fibre and count 1+6·5=31 follow. Replay: independent_check_1.py independently evaluates the equations on all 625 parameter quadruples modulo five and returns the six listed directions and 31 projective points; the scheme and length conclusions are algebraic, not inferred from finite points.
